deferred_source_units.source_text: He has been sent from the king and the seven advisers to inspect Judea and Jerusalem by the law of their God that is in your hand,
deferred_source_units.reason: The actual Saints Esther 1:14 names Arcesaeus, Sarsathaeus and Malesehar, not seven advisers. Their royal advisory position alone is too broad to establish the seven-member group or its identities in Ezra; the proposed match remains unretained.

target_units.text: He said to his friends, “Astin has spoken in this way; therefore establish law and judgment concerning this.”
Arcesaeus, Sarsathaeus, and Malesehar, the rulers of Persia and Media who were nearest the king and sat in the first places beside him, approached him
and reported to him, according to the laws, how Queen Astin must be dealt with, because she had not done what the king commanded through the eunuchs.
